title: Connect your social and advertising accounts.
summary: PostPlus helps you prepare content for Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube, and carry out supported publishing or engagement actions after your approval. Connect Meta Ads and Google Ads to plan campaigns, analyze results, and approve supported campaign launches and adjustments. Available actions depend on platform support and account permissions; TikTok account connections are currently limited to invited test users.
highlights: Connect social accounts to take content from preparation to supported publishing, scheduling, and engagement, with your approval.
Connect Meta Ads and Google Ads to plan campaigns, review performance, and carry out supported launches and adjustments after your approval.
The official installer handles the PostPlus runtime for you, without changing your system Node.js, and preserves existing account configuration.
